```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Root cause is bias-network mismatch, not sizing: cascode bias gives only ~0.1 V across the driver, so M1 is in triode, and the PMOS mirror is sized at different Vds, which pushes vbp near ground and puts M3 in triode. Fix: widen the Vgs split between reference and cascode, and size both PMOS devices at the same Vds so the mirror is exact."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":       (20e-6, 12e-6, 30e-6),  # branch current (driver = load)
    "L1":      (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # driver length
    "L2":      (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # cascode + reference length
    "L3":      (2.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS current-source length (high ro)
    "gmid2":   (10.0, 6.0, 12.0),      # cascode gm/Id (small Vgs2)
    "gmid_b":  (3.0, 2.5, 8.0),        # reference gm/Id (large Vgs -> vbn headroom for M1)
    "gmid_p":  (3.5, 3.0, 6.0),        # PMOS mirror gm/Id (high gm/gds for load)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    I = p["I"]
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vin = spec["vin_dc"]
    CL = spec["cl"]

    # Driver: width so that Id(vin) = I at Vds ~ 0.9 V
    unit = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, 0.9)
    W1 = max(0.42, I / unit["Id"])
    d1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, 0.9)

    # NMOS cascode: low gm/Id (small Vgs2). Reference: low gm/Id (large Vgs).
    # vbn - Vgs2 = x = headroom for M1 drain (must exceed Vdsat1 ~ 0.13 V)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I, vds=0.5)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L2"], Iref, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS load and mirror: both sized at same gm/Id, L and Vds, so
    # Vsg(M3) == Vsg(Mbp) and the mirror ratio is exactly I/Iref
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], I, vds=0.9)
    mbp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L3"], Iref, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])   # CS driver
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m2)              # NMOS cascode, gate = vbn
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)               # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("Mref", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)        # diode reference, carries Iref
    n.dev("Mn", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)            # NMOS copy, Iref sinks from vbp
    n.dev("Mbp", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)              # PMOS diode, Iref sourced from vdd

    # First-order predictions
    x = mref.vgs - m2.vgs                  # driver drain (cascode source) node
    vmin = x + m2.vdsat                    # lowest saturated output
    vmax = VDD - m3.vdsat                  # highest saturated output
    vdc = 0.5 * (vmin + vmax)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vdc - vmin, vmax - vdc)

    Rcas = (m2.gm / m2.gds) / d1["gds"]    # cascode output resistance seen by load
    Rout = 1.0 / (m3.gds + 1.0 / Rcas)
    A = d1["gm"] * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * CL)
    gbw = d1["gm"] / (2 * PI * CL)
    power = VDD * (I + 2 * Iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vdc,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
